name: Half and Half
siboNotes: Small amounts (1 tablespoon) may be tolerated during SIBO healing phases. Lactose-free versions are preferred for sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Use lactose-free half and half as a direct substitute
Start with small amounts (1 tablespoon) to test tolerance
Consider diluting with lactose-free milk for larger volumes
Store properly refrigerated and use within expiration date
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
Provides vitamin A for eye health
